versions.subject: Added Credential Dumping by LaZagne
versions.detection:
selection: 
    TargetImage: '*\lsass.exe'
    CallTrace: "C:\\Windows\\SYSTEM32\\ntdll.dll+*|C:\\Windows\\System32\\KERNELBASE.dll+*_ctypes.pyd+*python27.dll+*"
    GrantedAccess: "0x1FFFFF"
condition: selection
